profile.name: Simengxu Qiao
profile.intro: I am a doctoral student in Control Science and Engineering at Zhejiang University. My research studies structured temporal representations, multivariate dynamics, and knowledge-guided forecasting, with applications in industrial and biopharmaceutical processes.
profile.interests: I am interested in how temporal structure, operating state, and language-based knowledge can inform prediction. My work spans timestamp-aware modeling, conditional expert routing, and selective numerical–text fusion.

papers.name: SCF
papers.title: SCF: Source-Compositional Forecasting for Multimodal Time Series
papers.summary: Represent heterogeneous information as Numerical, Prior, Report, and Search forecasts, then compose them with availability-aware, sample–horizon factorized routing.

papers.name: VarBridge
papers.title: VarBridge: Bridging Process Dynamics and Variable-Specific Mechanistic Semantics for Bioprocess Forecasting
papers.summary: Bind each process variable to its mechanistic description and combine this semantics with historical state, variable identity, and forecast step through hierarchical expert fusion.

papers.name: GATE
papers.title: GATE: Gated Alignment of Temporal Queries for State-Aware Industrial Multivariate Forecasting
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Industrial Informatics · Under review
papers.summary: Use history- and forecast-oriented temporal queries to retrieve cross-variable context, and regulate its contribution through content relevance and current-state compatibility.

papers.name: Event-Time Alignment
papers.title: Understanding Time, Aligning Attention: Temporal Reasoning for Web Forecasting
papers.venue: The ACM Web Conference (WWW) 2027 · Under review
papers.summary: Connect public event dates to individual forecast days through event-relative representations and history-conditioned corrections of frozen numerical forecasts.

papers.name: TTW
papers.title: Explicit Timestamp Modeling for Long-term Time Series Forecasting via Pattern and Residual Fusion
papers.summary: Explicitly use timestamps to represent recurring temporal patterns, separate them from residual dynamics, and combine their forecasts.

papers.name: LMT-Net
papers.title: LMT-Net: A Hybrid Forecasting Framework with LLM-Guided Mechanistic Router Spatial Attention for Biochemical Industry Process
papers.summary: Use a language model to construct mechanistic relations and guide spatial attention for biochemical process forecasting.

papers.name: BPSN
papers.title: A Soft Sensor Net Based on the Symplectic Decomposition–Global Attention Reconstruction Architecture for Biopharmaceutical Industry
papers.summary: Combine structured signal decomposition, forecasting, and global-attention reconstruction for soft sensing in biopharmaceutical processes.

papers.name: ChronoGeom
papers.title: ChronoGeom: Distilling Task-Conditioned Temporal Priors into Minimal Forecasters
papers.summary: Study the transfer of task-conditioned temporal priors from language models into compact forecasting receivers, separating temporal assignment from receiver learning.
